info.title: EchoNova Developer API
info.description: Arabic-first speech AI: Text to Speech, Speech to Text and Sound Cleaning, plus tickets for the website widget. Every response uses the envelope { data, statusCode, success, errorMessage }.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Text to Speech
tags.description: Turn text into speech in one call, or as a job you poll or get a webhook for.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Speech to Text
tags.description: Transcribe audio files in one call, or as a job you poll or get a webhook for.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Sound Cleaning
tags.description: Remove noise and level the loudness of audio files in one call.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Agent Sessions
tags.description: Start a live voice or chat session with an agent, get its room token, read its status and end it. Needs a key with the agents:talk scope.

tags.name: Developer API - V1 Website Widget
tags.description: Mint single-use tickets that let your signed-in visitors start a private website widget.

bearer.description: An API key from the portal (Developers, API keys). It starts with ek_.

errorMessage.description: null on success, the error message on a failure.

docs.description: A link to the docs page that explains the error: Authentication for a 401, Errors otherwise.

jobId.description: The id of the job the call created.

status.description: processing once the request is accepted. Poll the job, or receive a job.completed webhook.

text.description: The text to speak, 1 to 500 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.
text.example: الطقس اليوم جميل والسماء صافية في المدينة

voiceId.description: The id of a voice from List available voices. The voice fixes the dialect.

cfg.description: How closely the voice follows the text. Leave it at the default unless you are tuning.

numSteps.description: Diffusion steps. More steps are slower and cleaner.

tashkeel.description: Adds the vowel marks to Arabic text before it is read. Applies to Fusha voices only.

normalize.description: Reads numbers, dates, times, money, units, URLs and e-mails the way a speaker of the voice's dialect says them. On unless you send false.

jobId.description: The id of the job the call created.

status.description: completed. A synchronous call creates its job already completed.

audioUrl.description: A signed link to the WAV file. It expires; read the job again for a fresh link.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

text.description: The text to speak, 1 to 500 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.
text.example: الطقس اليوم جميل والسماء صافية في المدينة

voiceId.description: The id of a voice from List available voices. The voice fixes the dialect.

cfg.description: How closely the voice follows the text. Leave it at the default unless you are tuning.

numSteps.description: Diffusion steps. More steps are slower and cleaner.

tashkeel.description: Adds the vowel marks to Arabic text before it is read. Applies to Fusha voices only.

normalize.description: Reads numbers, dates, times, money, units, URLs and e-mails the way a speaker of the voice's dialect says them. On unless you send false.

id.description: The value to send as voiceId.

displayName.description: Human label, e.g. "Ahmed". Falls back to name when unset.

language.description: ar for Arabic voices, en for English voices.

gender.description: The gender label, for example Male.

previewUrl.description: A link to a short audio sample of the voice, when one exists.

sessionId.description: The stream session the job came from. Every synthesis on one socket shares it, and it is the requestId of that session in the request logs.

requestId.description: The requestId of the synthesis: the one you sent, or the one the server made.

cancelled.description: true when the synthesis stopped early: cancel, a new synthesize, or the socket closing. The audio holds only what was sent.

audioDropped.description: true when the audio could not be saved. The text is kept; audioUrl stays null.

text.example: الطقس اليوم جميل والسماء صافية في المدينة

audioUrl.description: A signed link to the WAV file. It expires; read the job again for a fresh link. Null until the job completes.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

error.description: The reason the job failed. Null unless status is failed.

stream.description: Only on a job made by /v1/text-to-speech/stream: the session and synthesis it came from.

createdAt.description: When the job was created, ISO 8601 in UTC.

deleted.description: true once the job is deleted.

start.description: Where the piece starts, in seconds from the start of the audio.

end.description: Where the piece ends, in seconds from the start of the audio.

text.description: What was said in this piece.

speaker.description: The id of the speaker (spk0, spk1, ...), numbered by first appearance; null when the speaker is unknown.

id.description: The speaker id the segments use.

talkTime.description: How long this speaker talks, in seconds.

start.description: Where the replaced words start in raw, as a character offset.

end.description: Where the replaced words end in raw, as a character offset, end-exclusive.

replacement.description: Your term, as written in corrected.

stage.description: How it matched: exact (the term, one of your variants, or a spelled-out acronym), phonetic (sounds the same) or fuzzy (close spelling).

start.description: Where the words start in raw, as a character offset.

end.description: Where the words end in raw, as a character offset, end-exclusive.

detail.example: Fuzzy matching stopped early; exact matches are complete.

raw.description: The transcript as heard: the same text as transcription.
raw.example: حولت المبلغ عبر السويفت إلى امريتس ان بي دي أمس.

corrected.description: The transcript with your terms applied. Outside the edits it is identical to raw.
corrected.example: حولت المبلغ عبر الـSWIFT إلى Emirates NBD أمس.

nearMisses.description: Close matches that were not applied. Confirm them and send them back as variants next time.

warnings.description: Anything that limited the mapping, such as a list too large.

mapperStatus.description: applied, no_keywords, or skipped (the mapping could not run; corrected then equals raw and warnings says why).

jobId.description: The id of the job the call created.

status.description: completed. A synchronous call creates its job already completed.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds, as measured.

language.description: Language the transcription was requested with; null for jobs from before the field was required.

numbersAsDigits.description: Whether spoken numbers were written as digits. Jobs from before the option read true.

identifySpeakers.description: Whether speaker identification was requested with identify_speakers. Jobs from before the option read false.

segments.description: The transcript in timed pieces, each with its speaker, sorted by start. Empty unless speakers were identified.

speakers.description: The speakers heard, in order of first appearance. Empty unless speakers were identified.

terminology.description: The transcript corrected to the terms sent in terminology, with each edit and any near misses. Absent when no terms were sent.

sessionId.description: The id of the stream session the job came from.

transcription.description: The transcript text. Absent until the job completes.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds. An estimate while processing, the measured length once completed.

language.description: Language the transcription was requested with; null for jobs from before the field was required.

numbersAsDigits.description: Whether spoken numbers were written as digits. Jobs from before the option read true.

identifySpeakers.description: Whether speaker identification was requested with identify_speakers. Jobs from before the option read false.

segments.description: The transcript in timed pieces, each with its speaker, sorted by start. Empty unless speakers were identified.

speakers.description: The speakers heard, in order of first appearance. Empty unless speakers were identified.

terminology.description: The transcript corrected to the terms sent in terminology, with each edit and any near misses. Absent when no terms were sent.

stream.description: Only on jobs from the speech-to-text stream: the session they came from.

audioUrl.description: Only on jobs from the speech-to-text stream: a signed link to the recording. It expires; get the job again for a fresh one.

error.description: The reason the job failed. Absent unless status is failed.

createdAt.description: When the job was created, ISO 8601 in UTC.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the cleaned file in Hz.

bitDepth.description: Bits per sample of the cleaned file.

integratedLufs.description: Measured loudness of the cleaned file in LUFS.

truePeakDbfs.description: Measured peak of the cleaned file in dBFS.

fileName.description: The name of the uploaded file.

outputUrl.description: Time-limited link to the cleaned WAV.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

options.description: The tuning values the job ran with.

error.description: The reason the job failed. Absent unless status is failed.
error.example: The audio could not be cleaned.

createdAt.description: When the job was created, ISO 8601 in UTC.

ticket.description: The single-use ticket. Hand it to the visitor browser; it starts one session.

expiresAt.description: When the ticket stops working, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

id.description: Your own id for the visitor, 1 to 128 characters, no control characters. The widget's per-visitor daily limit counts by it.

name.description: The visitor name shown in Conversations, up to 80 characters. Control characters are removed.

user.description: The signed-in visitor this ticket is for.

channel.description: Restricts the ticket to one channel. Leave it out to allow both.

ttlSeconds.description: Seconds the ticket stays valid, from 60 to 900. It works once.

id.description: The session id; also the conversation id once it ends.

channel.description: voice for a room you speak in, chat for a text session.

status.description: active while it is open; ended after you end it or it finishes; failed or out_of_credits when it stopped early.

startedAt.description: When it started, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

endedAt.description: When it ended; null while it is open.

token.description: The room token. It is sent once, here, and never again: keep it secret and hand it only to the client that joins.

wsUrl.description: The room address the client connects to with the token.

greeting.description: A chat session's first agent message, to show before the agent speaks; null for voice.

channel.description: voice opens a room you join with the returned token; chat opens a text session. Defaults to voice.

id.description: The session id; also the conversation id once it ends.

channel.description: voice for a room you speak in, chat for a text session.

status.description: active while it is open; ended after you end it or it finishes; failed or out_of_credits when it stopped early.

startedAt.description: When it started, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

endedAt.description: When it ended; null while it is open.
